verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm whose core product is legal counsel (company formation, financings, IP litigation, privacy, and similar matters), so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. Its ancillary web tools (the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon apps) are free hosted resources, and nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable or deployable software distribution that would make this axis apply.
